# lnurlcash-go

LNURLcash (LUD-25) bearer note client for Go. MIT.

go get github.com/TheCryptoDonkey/lnurlcash-go

## CRITICAL: HTTP retries

Every LNURLcash mutation (rotate/split/merge/melt) is an HTTP GET, but is NOT
idempotent - the first attempt burns the input note. net/http retries an
idempotent request sent on a REUSED connection, and a client with no Transport
uses the process-wide http.DefaultTransport pool. A retried mutation gets
"already spent" for its second attempt and reports a DEFINITIVE rejection, so
the caller discards the fresh secret that was the only copy of the note.

NewClient() sets DisableKeepAlives for this reason. A caller-supplied
*http.Client MUST do the same.

## API

client := lnurlcash.NewClient()   // fields: HTTP, Timeout, Offline, Secrets

client.FetchNoteInfo(ctx, url) (WithdrawInfo, error)   // MaxWithdrawableMsat is authoritative
client.RotateNote(ctx, callback, k1) (RotatedNote, error)
client.SplitNote(ctx, callback, k1s, amountMsat) (SplitNotes, error)
client.MergeNotes(ctx, callback, k1s) (RotatedNote, error)
client.MeltNote(ctx, callback, k1, pr) (Mutation, error)
client.SettleNote(ctx, baseURL, k1, expectedMsat, sig) (SettledNote, error)
client.ProbeBurnedNote(ctx, url) NoteFate    // NoteLive | NoteGone | NoteFateUnknown
client.FetchPayRequest / RequestInvoice / FetchInvoiceStatus / FetchMintAddress

Pure functions: VerifyNoteSignature, GenerateNoteSecret, HashK1, IsPreimage,
ResolveNoteInput, ResolveMintInput, ResolveLnurlInput, IsAllowedServiceURL,
BuildNoteURL, WithNewK1, WithoutK1, NoteK1, NoteDeclaredAmountMsat,
NoteSignature, ParseMintFee, ApplyMintFee, GrossUpForMintFee, DescribeMintFee,
DecodeBolt11AmountMsat, IsBolt11Invoice, SameInvoice.

No-I/O protocol layer: RotateRequest / SplitRequest / MergeRequest /
MeltRequest / NoteInfoRequest / InvoiceRequest / VerifyRequest return
Request{URL, NewSecrets}; ParseNoteInfo / ParseMutation / ParseInvoice /
ParseVerify / ParsePayRequest / ParseMintAddress read the body.

Amounts are int64 milli-satoshis everywhere.

## Errors

errors.Is(err, ErrRequestRefused)  nothing sent, note untouched
errors.Is(err, ErrNotePending)     a melt is in flight - retry, NOT spent
IsSpent(err)                       authoritative: already burned
IsUnknownNote(err)                 service does not recognise it
IsAmbiguous(err)                   outcome UNKNOWN - assume nothing
NewSecrets(err)                    the secrets an ambiguous mutation carried
*ProtocolError                     a non-mutating response did not match the spec

## Rules

1. MaxWithdrawableMsat is the ONLY authoritative value; a note URL's amount is a claim.
2. The wallet generates replacement secrets; never accept a service-supplied k1.
3. On IsAmbiguous: persist NewSecrets(err) FIRST, then ProbeBurnedNote.
4. A melt's success means IN FLIGHT. ErrNotePending means retry, not spent.
5. Rotate immediately after claiming a minted note.
6. Never log note URLs - the secret is in the query string.

## Conformance

https://github.com/TheCryptoDonkey/lnurlcash-conformance
